name: Manual entry is a clear reversible action
description: A user without a Google Business Profile can visibly switch to manual entry and return to lookup.

planSteps.description: Open a valid unused test invitation link to /onboard/
Enter details manually appears as a visually distinct button next to the Google Business Profile fallback message
A Manual details panel is visible with a clickable Use Google lookup instead action
The business listing search field and Find listing button are visible again
